import numpy as np

# Reference orientations
Q0_DOWN_X = np.array([0.0, 0.707, 0.707, 0.0])     # arm0 facing down, fingers open along X (handle runs along Y)
Q1_DOWN_X = np.array([0.0, 0.707, -0.707, 0.0])    # arm1 facing down, fingers open along X (90deg yaw of [0,0,1,0])

HANDOVER_X = 0.81        # midpoint between initial gripper x positions (0.44 and 1.18)
HANDOVER_Z = 0.175       # hammer z must be within [0.15, 0.20]
LIFT_Z = 0.32            # safe travel height
ARM0_GRASP_OFF = 0.06    # arm0 grasps toward handle end (+Y)
ARM1_GRASP_OFF = -0.05   # arm1 grasps toward handle middle/head side (-Y); 11cm separation between grippers

# Step 0: open grippers, park arm1 out of the way (high, on its own side)
open_gripper_arm0()
open_gripper_arm1()
goto_pose_arm1(np.array([1.05, 0.0, LIFT_Z]), Q1_DOWN_X)

# Step 1: locate hammer (middle of handle). Handle is along Y, handle end toward +Y.
h_pos, _ = get_hammer_pose()
hx, hy, hz = float(h_pos[0]), float(h_pos[1]), float(h_pos[2])

# Step 2: arm0 grasps the handle near the +Y end, approaching from above
grasp0 = np.array([hx, hy + ARM0_GRASP_OFF, hz])
goto_pose_arm0(grasp0, Q0_DOWN_X, z_approach=0.12)
close_gripper_arm0()

# Step 3: lift straight up, translate toward the midpoint, then lower to handover height (pure translations)
goto_pose_arm0(np.array([hx, hy + ARM0_GRASP_OFF, LIFT_Z]), Q0_DOWN_X)
goto_pose_arm0(np.array([HANDOVER_X, hy + ARM0_GRASP_OFF, LIFT_Z]), Q0_DOWN_X)
goto_pose_arm0(np.array([HANDOVER_X, hy + ARM0_GRASP_OFF, HANDOVER_Z]), Q0_DOWN_X)

# Step 4: arm1 moves above the handover point, then descends vertically onto the handle (-Y part, away from arm0 gripper)
goto_pose_arm1(np.array([HANDOVER_X + 0.15, hy + ARM1_GRASP_OFF, LIFT_Z]), Q1_DOWN_X)
goto_pose_arm1(np.array([HANDOVER_X, hy + ARM1_GRASP_OFF, HANDOVER_Z]), Q1_DOWN_X, z_approach=0.12)
close_gripper_arm1()

# Step 5: arm0 releases and retreats up and back toward its own side
open_gripper_arm0()
goto_pose_arm0(np.array([HANDOVER_X, hy + ARM0_GRASP_OFF, LIFT_Z]), Q0_DOWN_X)
goto_pose_arm0(np.array([0.5, hy + ARM0_GRASP_OFF, LIFT_Z]), Q0_DOWN_X)
